// Set job parameters for CourtListener bulk ingestion
const now = new Date();

return [{
  json: {
    source_id: 'src_courtlistener',
    connector_id: 'courtlistener',
    product: 'Civic',
    tenant_id: 'shared',
    workspace_id: 'shared',
    idempotency_key: 'courtlistener-bulk-' + now.getTime() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
    contract_version: 1,
    mode: 'scrape',
    provider: 'spider_unlimited',
    required_proxy: 'webshare',
    preflight_required: true,
    direct_fallback_allowed: false,
    max_pages: 100,
    deadline_seconds: 3600,
    target_url: 'https://com-courtlistener-storage.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/?list-type=2&prefix=bulk-data/',
    file_types: [
      'dockets',
      'people-db-people',
      'people-db-educations',
      'people-db-positions',
      'people-db-political-affiliations',
      'people-db-schools',
      'people-db-retention-events',
      'people_db_race'
    ],
    start_date: '2023-01-01',
    end_date: now.toISOString().split('T')[0],
    provenance: {
      source: 'CourtListener Bulk Data',
      url: 'https://com-courtlistener-storage.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/',
      license: 'Public Domain (RECAP)',
      retrieved_at: now.toISOString(),
      data_format: 'CSV.bz2'
    },
    scope: {
      organization_id: 'harvy',
      product_id: 'harvy-ingestion',
      environment: 'production'
    }
  }
}];

meta.description: CourtListener bulk data ingestion workflow using spider.cloud and Webshare proxy. INACTIVE - requires credential configuration and Harvy domain setup.
